  "tokenized_directions": [
    {
      "step": 1,
      "text": "A dish of stuffed {{ing_01|pumpkin}} is made thus: Peel and cut the {{ing_01|pumpkin}} lengthwise into oblong pieces which hollow out and put in a cool place."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "text": "The dressing for the same make in this way: Crush {{ing_02|pepper}}, {{ing_03|lovage}} and {{ing_04|origany}}, moistened with {{ing_05|broth}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "text": "Mince {{ing_06|cooked brains}} and beat {{ing_07|raw eggs}} and mix all together to form a paste."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "text": "Add {{ing_05|broth}} as taste requires."
    },
    {
      "step": 5,
      "text": "Stuff the above prepared pieces of {{ing_01|pumpkin}} that have not been fully cooked with the dressing."
    },
    {
      "step": 6,
      "text": "Fit two pieces together and close them tight."
    },
    {
      "step": 7,
      "text": "Take the cooked ones out and fry them."
    },
    {
      "step": 8,
      "text": "Wine sauce make thus: Crush {{ing_02|pepper}}, {{ing_03|lovage}} moistened with {{ing_08|wine}}, {{ing_09|raisin wine}} to taste, {{ing_10|a little oil}}, place in pan to be cooked; when done bind with {{ing_11|roux}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 9,
      "text": "Cover the fried {{ing_01|pumpkin}} with this sauce, sprinkle with {{ing_02|pepper}} and serve."
    }
  ],
